title: T-107 Slice 2 — MECH_03 ¡CORRE! on the v2 contract (adapt RunnerSim, jump-only)
description: Slice 2 of the TASK-034 (GDD T-107) split — largest delta. CONTROL SCOPE RULED (human 2026-07-07): jump-only, one FIXED lane per player. STRIP RunnerSim's lane-switching, slide/duck, and high-obstacle types entirely — the GDD control scheme is only mash-accelerate + stick-up-tap-jump ('nunca al revés'). Adapt RunnerSim.cs to the canonical §10.2 v2 IMicrogame contract (engine-free, injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick): button MASH accelerates via the §3.3 curve from InputInterpreter (v = vBase + vGain·mashNorm) — replacing RunnerSim's auto-accelerate; stick-up TAP jumps; obstacle hit = 0.6 s stun (NOT elimination); rubber-band +8% vBase for last place; and re-architect spawn generation so ONE seed produces an IDENTICAL obstacle track shared across all 4 players' lanes (RunnerSim currently gives each instance its own RNG stream — this must change). Declare difficultyScaling; pass the TASK-030 validator. The pending human camera UAT is View-level (§10.4) and stays out of this Core slice. Sequence this LAST among the mechanic slices.
acceptance_criteria: MECH_03 implements the v2 IMicrogame contract as an engine-free Core sim (injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick); one fixed lane per player, NO lane-switching, NO slide, NO high obstacles (ruled jump-only).
Mash accelerates via the InputInterpreter §3.3 curve (v = vBase + vGain·mashNorm); stick-up tap jumps (never the reverse mapping); obstacle hit = 0.6 s stun, no elimination.
The same seed produces an identical obstacle track in all 4 lanes (single shared generation, verified by test).

A bot at constant 6 Hz mash with perfect jumps finishes unstunned; rubber-band (+8% vBase last place) never inverts the result between two players with identical mash over 1000 seeds (statistical test).
The v2 definition declares difficultyScaling params and passes the TASK-030 validator.
Tests-first (red captured); fast suite green, no regression; legacy consumers keep compiling; camera/View UAT deferred to §10.4 work.
